expected_structural_delta: Removes one engine option, one validation function, one job mount, and one test file. Adds one assertion for the retired key.
minimum_design: Delete crf_shared_cache_mount, its callers, the runner bind, the fingerprint salt, the CFG_KEYS and default.cfg entries, the README section, and tests/shared-cache.sh. Rely on the existing load_cfg allowlist to ignore the retired key, and prove that with a focused test.
outcome: Runner containers no longer receive a SeaweedFS bind or CI_SHARED_CACHE, and a saved configuration that still names SHARED_CACHE_ROOT loads without error.

reuse_decisions.name: load_cfg CFG_KEYS allowlist
reuse_decisions.rationale: load_cfg already skips any key outside the allowlist, so an old line needs no migration code.

reuse_decisions.name: configuration fingerprint
reuse_decisions.rationale: An empty root never added salt, so hosts that already cleared it keep their fingerprint and do not rotate.

reuse_decisions.name: ARTIFACT_ENDPOINT
reuse_decisions.rationale: A generic firewall feature that does not depend on SeaweedFS.
